content: Discrete-event pattern: min-heap keyed by dueTick, jump to earliest event, deterministic tie-break by sequence. System.Collections.Generic.PriorityQueue<TElement,TPriority> exists only in net6.0+ (not netstandard2.1, so absent in Unity) and does not guarantee FIFO for equal priorities; the core must ship its own heap with explicit (dueTick, seq) ordering.
